title: Abagenzi bo mu murima w'ivyatsi bitotahaye
intro: Mu bihe vya kera, abantu babiri bariko barabungabunga ibihugu bihegereye. Inzira zabo zari zifatanye, yamara imitima yabo yarabajana mu bibanza bitandukanye cane. Umwe yagenda mu nzira igororotse, uwundi na we akaja mu mwiza w’ukwihakana. Woba ushobora gusobanura akabanga k’abo barinzi babiri b’umwimbu?
clues: Nari mfise ivyimburwa vyinshi, umwimbu mwiza cane watangaza amaso y’abarorerezi.
Umubanyi wanje yari afise mbere n’ubutunzi bwinshi kuruta ubwanje, yamara naripfuza umugabane wabo kuruta uwanje.
Naciye ngira inama yo gusenyura ibiterwa vyabo vyose, kugira ngo dukomeze vyose biri munsi y’ububasha bwanje.
Nanje nyene narasenyuye umwimbu wanje, nsenya vyose mu mugambi wanje w’ubupfu.
Nahagaze ata co nkora igihe ibiterwa vyanje vyaguma vyuma, ubutunzi bwanje bugahinduka inkungugu mw’ijoro rimwe.
Nta mugabane nari mfise mu nyuma y’urupfu, kandi aho nari mba ha nyuma hacitse ikinogo c’umuriro ururumba.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Umurimyi yipfuza ubutaka bwa mubanyi wabo

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Itegeko ryo gusangira iragi mu buryo bubereye .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Gusambura burundu ivyimburwa vyose bibiri muri ubu buzima .
Uguterimbere kw'igihe gito kukurikiwe n'umuriro w'ibihe bidahera
Gusubirana kw’igitangaza be n’ubutunzi bugwijwe kabiri .
outcome.answer: Gusambura burundu ivyimburwa vyose bibiri muri ubu buzima .

verse: Then they approached one another, blaming each other. (68:30)
